reread.consequence: Size needs equal group dispersion even with equal groups. The documentation states that a rejection is evidence of a difference in trajectory or in dispersion, for the statistics and scales the map gives, in balanced designs too, and the interpretability statement of each failing statistic gains that clause. A case study that rejects reports the two groups' residual dispersion in the scores beside the rejection. The roadmap opens a diagnosis of the excess the within-group draws leave, and after it a change for a null or a fit that holds size, and notes that open item 3's bias correction needs a per-group trace. The readings hold for simulated Gaussian noise at 658 features, one scale applied to every feature of one group, three stages and no covariates; a difference in correlation structure was not simulated and no real cohort's dispersion was read. No verdict changes what `motco analyze` runs. Under any verdict the recorded arms say whether the per-feature tests share the reading, and the roadmap's "Not yet established" entries on unbalance and on noise are updated.
